key: \PN activated the pillar!
en: \PN activated the pillar!
ja: \PNは、柱を起動した!

key: ...again.
en: ...again.
ja: …また。

key: \PN activated the pillar and wondered how many more arbitrary obstacles they would have to get through before the next interesting thing happened.
en: \PN activated the pillar and wondered how many more arbitrary obstacles they would have to get through before the next interesting thing happened.
ja: \PNは柱を起動し、次に面白いことが起こるまで、あとどれだけ理不尽な障害を越えなきゃいけないんだろうと考えた。

key: as \PN activated the pillar, they wondered exactly why their actions were being narrated in such a peculiar way.
en: as \PN activated the pillar, they wondered exactly why their actions were being narrated in such a peculiar way.
ja: \PNが柱を起動する間、自分の行動がなぜこんな奇妙な形でナレーションされているのか、不思議に思った。

key: but really, they should've been wondering why the narration had ever been normal in the first place.
en: but really, they should've been wondering why the narration had ever been normal in the first place.
ja: しかし本当は、そもそもこのナレーションが普通だった時があったのか、それを疑うべきだった。

key: also, how does one even "activate" a pillar?
en: also, how does one even "activate" a pillar?
ja: そもそも、柱ってどうやって「起動」するものなのだろう?

key: it's a pillar.
en: it's a pillar.
ja: ただの柱なのに。

key: as \PN activated the pillar, doubts began to seep into their mind about what system of justice they had any authority to act under.
en: as \PN activated the pillar, doubts began to seep into their mind about what system of justice they had any authority to act under.
ja: \PNが柱を起動する間、自分がいったいどんな正義の体系のもとに行動する権限を持っているのか、疑念が心にしみ込み始めた。

key: what ARE they trying to accomplish here?
en: what ARE they trying to accomplish here?
ja: そもそも、ここで何を成し遂げようとしているのだろう?

key: poaching is a crime, but what does "poaching pokemon" even mean? and what makes it any different from catching?
en: poaching is a crime, but what does "poaching pokemon" even mean? and what makes it any different from catching?
ja: 密猟は犯罪だが、「ポケモンの密猟」とは一体何を意味するのか? それは捕獲と何が違うというのか?

key: isn't it just an arbitrary distinction between "good" catching and "bad" catching?
en: isn't it just an arbitrary distinction between "good" catching and "bad" catching?
ja: それはただ、「良い」捕獲と「悪い」捕獲の間の、恣意的な区別にすぎないのではないか?

key: these people are just doing what every trainer does. if anything, all you're accomplishing here is interfering with things that really aren't your business.
en: these people are just doing what every trainer does.  if anything, all you're accomplishing here is interfering with things that really aren't your business.
ja: この者たちは、どのトレーナーもやっていることをしているだけだ。むしろここで成し遂げているのは、本当は自分に関係のないことへの干渉でしかない。

key: ...but if these people are "bad", what is it that makes you "good"?
en: ...but if these people are "bad", what is it that makes you "good"?
ja: …だが、この者たちが「悪」だというなら、自分を「善」たらしめているものは何なのか?

key: you stroll through these doors and catch everything you can, just because the pokemon are "legendary".
en: you stroll through these doors and catch everything you can, just because the pokemon are "legendary".
ja: 「伝説の」ポケモンだからというだけの理由で、扉を通り抜けて捕まえられる限りのものを捕まえている。

key: what makes you better than them?
en: what makes you better than them?
ja: それの何が、彼らより優れているというのか?

key: notions of friendship, compliance, and an ideal sold by pokéball marketing companies that somehow the inside of one is a luxury resort?
en: notions of friendship, compliance, and an ideal sold by pokéball marketing companies that somehow the inside of one is a luxury resort?
ja: 友情という概念、従順さ、そしてモンスターボールの製造会社が売り込む、その中がどういうわけか高級リゾートだという理想――そんなものだろうか?

key: but that idea is just for YOUR peace of mind.
en: but that idea is just for YOUR peace of mind.
ja: しかしその考えは、ただ自分自身の心を安らかにするためのものに過ぎない。

key: because how else could you feel comfortable buying their products to force creatures into submission?
en: because how else could you feel comfortable buying their products to force creatures into submission?
ja: そうでなければ、生き物を服従させるための製品を、平気な顔で買うことなどできないだろうから。

key: either way they're just tools and data that you've arbitrarily decided to force your own feelings on to justify their utility.
en: either way they're just tools and data that you've arbitrarily decided to force your own feelings on to justify their utility.
ja: どのみち、それらはただの道具でありデータであり、その有用性を正当化するために、自分の感情を恣意的に押し付けているだけなのだ。

key: and let's not even get STARTED on PC boxes.
en: and let's not even get STARTED on PC boxes.
ja: それに、パソコンのボックスの話なんて、もう始めないでおこう。

key: how many Pokémon have you caught just to leave in there?
en: how many Pokémon have you caught just to leave in there?
ja: そこに放置するためだけに、一体何匹のポケモンを捕まえてきたのか?

key: how many stories of "trust" and "friendship", and how many arbitrary decisions have led to creatures living out the rest of their days in the form of data?
en: how many stories of "trust" and "friendship", and how many arbitrary decisions have led to creatures living out the rest of their days in the form of data?
ja: 「信頼」だの「友情」だの、そんな物語がいくつあって、いったいどれだけ恣意的な決断が、生き物たちをデータの姿のまま残りの生涯を過ごさせることになったわけ?

key: do you even know how many you have trapped in your PC right now?
en: do you even know how many you have trapped in your PC right now?
ja: 今この瞬間、自分のパソコンに何匹閉じ込めてるか、把握してるわけ?

key: and what about all the other trainers-- who've just been left behind to gather dust like cartridges of games that nobody plays anymore?
en: and what about all the other trainers-- who've just been left behind to gather dust like cartridges of games that nobody plays anymore?
ja: それに、他のトレーナーたちはどうなの――誰も遊ばなくなったゲームのカートリッジみたいに、ほこりをかぶったまま置き去りにされたトレーナーたちは?

key: how many "friends" are rotting in the confines of forgotten adventures and old save files?
en: how many "friends" are rotting in the confines of forgotten adventures and old save files?
ja: 忘れられた冒険や古いセーブデータの中で、腐りかけてる「友達」って何人いるわけ?

key: can you really go on deluding yourself into thinking that's okay?
en: can you really go on deluding yourself into thinking that's okay?
ja: それでいいんだって、本気で自分をだまし続けられる?

key: that just as soon as i stop talking, you can just go about your adventure without taking any real accountability?
en: that just as soon as i stop talking, you can just go about your adventure without taking any real accountability?
ja: アタシが話すのをやめた瞬間、何の責任も取らずに、また冒険に戻れると思ってる?

key: why don't we go fix the problem here and now instead of continuing a cycle of guilt and willful ignorance?
en: why don't we go fix the problem here and now instead of continuing a cycle of guilt and willful ignorance?
ja: 罪悪感と見て見ぬふりのループを続けるくらいなら、今ここで問題を解決した方がよくない?

key: LIN: there're Pokémon here that-- let's be honest-- you never intend to use again.
en: LIN: there're Pokémon here that-- let's be honest-- you never intend to use again.
ja: リン: ここに、正直言って、もう二度と使うつもりのないポケモンがいるでしょ。

key: if you ever even did.
en: if you ever even did.
ja: そもそも一度でも使ったことがあるならの話だけど。

key: release them.
en: release them.
ja: 逃がしなさい。

key: LIN: huh.
en: LIN: huh.
ja: リン: へえ。

key: that's better than i expected.
en: that's better than i expected.
ja: 思ってたよりマシじゃん。

key: don't tell me you actually had a change of heart or, barkeus forbid, learned something???
en: don't tell me you actually had a change of heart or, barkeus forbid, learned something???
ja: まさか本当に心を入れ替えたとか、アルセウスならぬバルケウスに誓って、何か学んだとか言わないよね???

key: never thought i'd see the day.
en: never thought i'd see the day.
ja: こんな日が来るとは思わなかった。

key: your selfless actions have made the world a better place.
en: your selfless actions have made the world a better place.
ja: あんたの無私の行動が、世界をちょっとマシにしたわけ。

key: tell you what, as a reward, you can have this.
en: tell you what, as a reward, you can have this.
ja: そうだ、ご褒美にこれあげる。

key: consider it a tribute from those you've spared.
en: consider it a tribute from those you've spared.
ja: あんたに救われた子たちからの贈り物だと思って。

key: LIN: something something ash from the flames like a phoenix, uhh cycle of rebirth...?????
en: LIN: something something ash from the flames like a phoenix, uhh cycle of rebirth...?????
ja: リン: なんかこう、フェニックスみたいに灰からよみがえる、みたいな、りんね転生的な…?????

key: idk this metaphor is hard.
en: idk this metaphor is hard.
ja: わかんない、この比喩むずすぎ。

key: i don't get paid enough for metaphors.
en: i don't get paid enough for metaphors.
ja: 比喩考えるための給料、もらってないし。

key: though i suppose i don't need money.
en: though i suppose i don't need money.
ja: まあ、お金なんて要らないんだけど。

key: i already have everything~
en: i already have everything~
ja: アタシもうすべて持ってるし～

key: fine.
en: fine.
ja: はいはい。

key: it's a start.
en: it's a start.
ja: 始まりってことで。

key: now you're free to go about your anti-poacher business pretending as if you have any legitimate claim to moral superiority over them.
en: now you're free to go about your anti-poacher business pretending as if you have any legitimate claim to moral superiority over them.
ja: これで、密猟者より道徳的に優れてるフリをして、正義のビジネスに戻っていいわよ。

key: let's do this again sometime.
en: let's do this again sometime.
ja: また今度やろうね。

key: okay, okay, that's enough.
en: okay, okay, that's enough.
ja: はいはい、もう十分。

key: congratulations, you did it.
en: congratulations, you did it.
ja: おめでとう、やったじゃん。

key: your profound determination and headstrong adherence to doing the right thing only when absolutely required to has spared you on this day.
en: your profound determination and headstrong adherence to doing the right thing only when absolutely required to has spared you on this day.
ja: 本当に必要な時だけ正しいことをするっていう、あんたの深い決意と頑固なこだわりのおかげで、今日のところは見逃してあげる。

key: also me. i'm sparing you.
en: also me. i'm sparing you.
ja: あとアタシも。アタシがあんたを見逃してあげてるの。

key: this was getting boring anyway.
en: this was getting boring anyway.
ja: どのみち飽きてきたし。

key: nope. more.
en: nope. more.
ja: ダメ、もっと。

key: okay, i see what you're doing here.
en: okay, i see what you're doing here.
ja: はいはい、何やろうとしてるかわかってるから。

key: you're thinking you can get around this by just releasing one Pokémon at a time until you hit whatever the minimum arbitrary number i'll be satisfied with is.
en: you're thinking you can get around this by just releasing one Pokémon at a time until you hit whatever the minimum arbitrary number i'll be satisfied with is.
ja: ポケモンを1匹ずつ逃がしていけば、アタシが満足する適当な最低数にたどり着くまで、それでごまかせると思ってるでしょ。

key: so fine.
en: so fine.
ja: ま、いいよ。

key: i'll bite.
en: i'll bite.
ja: 乗ってあげる。

key: i'm thinking of a number between 1 aaaaaaand...
en: i'm thinking of a number between 1 aaaaaaand...
ja: 1から……

key: fifty.
en: fifty.
ja: 50の間の数字を思い浮かべてる。

key: so sure, you can go after you reach it.
en: so sure, you can go after you reach it.
ja: その数に到達したら、行っていいわ。

key: good luck.
en: good luck.
ja: 頑張って。

key: ...really?
en: ...really?
ja: …マジで?

key: just one?
en: just one?
ja: たった1匹?

key: one measly Pokémon is all you're willing to part with after everything we just talked about?
en: one measly Pokémon is all you're willing to part with after everything we just talked about?
ja: 今までさんざん話したのに、手放す気があるのはたった1匹のみすぼらしいポケモンだけってわけ?

key: did you think that was just going to flip a switch and we'd be done here?
en: did you think that was just going to flip a switch and we'd be done here?
ja: それでスイッチが切り替わって、これで終わりだと思ってた?

key: i mean, i know i practically write the guidebook on malicious compliance, but come on.
en: i mean, i know i practically write the guidebook on malicious compliance, but come on.
ja: まあ、アタシはほぼ悪意ある従順の教科書を書いてるようなもんだけど、それにしたって。

key: i'm not stupid.
en: i'm not stupid.
ja: アタシはバカじゃないの。

key: and i AM watching.
en: and i AM watching.
ja: それにちゃんと見てるから。

key: you can do better.
en: you can do better.
ja: もっとできるでしょ。

key: try again.
en: try again.
ja: もう一回やり直し。

key: what, just two?
en: what, just two?
ja: え、たった2匹?

key: what'd those two do, pee in your morning cereal?
en: what'd those two do, pee in your morning cereal?
ja: その2匹、朝のシリアルにおしっこでもした?

key: i'd say shit in your wheaties, but the only person who would ever eat that bland garbage is samson.
en: i'd say shit in your wheaties, but the only person who would ever eat that bland garbage is samson.
ja: 『あんたのウィーティーズにうんこした』とでも言いたいとこだけど、あんなパサパサのゴミ食べるのはサムソンくらいのもんでしょ。

key: you can do better than that, can't you?
en: you can do better than that, can't you?
ja: それよりマシにできるでしょ?

key: you should report this message as a bug if you happen to get it because that means you negative released a Pokémon???? how even?? what did you DO?
en: you should report this message as a bug if you happen to get it because that means you negative released a Pokémon????  how even?? what did you DO?
ja: もしこのメッセージが出てるなら、それはバグとして報告すべきよ、だってそれ、ポケモンをマイナス匹逃がしたってことだから???? どうやって?? 一体何やったの?

key: you obviously don't get the situation you're in here.
en: you obviously don't get the situation you're in here.
ja: 自分の置かれてる状況、明らかにわかってないでしょ。

key: maybe you're scared of pressing the release button. like doing so is, itself, some kind of moral violation.
en: maybe you're scared of pressing the release button.  like doing so is, itself, some kind of moral violation.
ja: もしかして、逃がすボタンを押すのが怖いの? それ自体が何か道徳違反みたいに感じてる?

key: you're granting pokemon their freedom instead of languishing in an incorporeal state for the rest of their infinite lives.
en: you're granting pokemon their freedom instead of languishing in an incorporeal state for the rest of their infinite lives.
ja: 無限の生をずっと実体のない状態で朽ち果てさせるより、ポケモンに自由を与えてるだけなのに。

key: or maybe you feel clever for just closing the box.
en: or maybe you feel clever for just closing the box.
ja: それとも、ただボックスを閉じるだけで賢いつもりになってる?

key: in that case, the only thing you've accomplished is demonstrating your dedication to willful entrapment and slavery.
en: in that case, the only thing you've accomplished is demonstrating your dedication to willful entrapment and slavery.
ja: だとしたら、あんたが成し遂げたのは、故意の監禁と奴隷制への献身を証明しただけよ。

key: either way, i think you misunderstand your situation.
en: either way, i think you misunderstand your situation.
ja: どっちにしろ、自分の状況を誤解してると思うわ。

key: i don't HAVE to let you go.
en: i don't HAVE to let you go.
ja: アタシがあんたを行かせなきゃいけない義理なんてないの。

key: so let's try this again.
en: so let's try this again.
ja: だから、もう一回やってみましょ。

key: release your Pokémon.
en: release your Pokémon.
ja: ポケモンを逃がしなさい。

key: i understand not wanting to do what you're told-- really, i get it,
en: i understand not wanting to do what you're told-- really, i get it,
ja: 言われた通りにしたくない気持ちはわかる――マジで、わかるって、

key: but where i came from, that's called a power struggle!
en: but where i came from, that's called a power struggle!
ja: でもアタシのいたところじゃ、それは権力争いって言うのよ!

key: and for all my edgy puppet's lines, one thing is still true:
en: and for all my edgy puppet's lines, one thing is still true:
ja: アタシのとがった操り人形のセリフはさておき、ひとつだけ変わらない事実がある――

key: i hold all the power here.
en: i hold all the power here.
ja: ここでの権力は全部アタシが握ってるってこと。

key: this ISN'T optional.
en: this ISN'T optional.
ja: これは選択の余地なんてないの。

key: and you're not getting out of here until you release your Pokémon.
en: and you're not getting out of here until you release your Pokémon.
ja: ポケモンを逃がすまで、ここから出られないから。

key: your commitment to your lack of ideals is truly touching,
en: your commitment to your lack of ideals is truly touching,
ja: 理想の欠如への、そのこだわりには本当に感動するわ、

key: you know, in a, like, "show us where on the doll he touched you" kind of way.
en: you know, in a, like, "show us where on the doll he touched you" kind of way.
ja: その、ほら、『どこ触られたか人形で指して』的な意味で。

key: despite charging in face first to stop the poachers like some kind of hero, the only thing you're proving is how you're only interested in breaking systems of control when it suits you.
en: despite charging in face first to stop the poachers like some kind of hero, the only thing you're proving is how you're only interested in breaking systems of control when it suits you.
ja: 密猟者を止めるためにヒーロー気取りで突っ込んでいったくせに、証明できたのは、都合のいい時だけ管理システムを壊すことに興味があるってことだけなのよね。

key: you just want all the power for yourself.
en: you just want all the power for yourself.
ja: 結局、権力を独り占めしたいだけなんでしょ。

key: think i'm wrong?
en: think i'm wrong?
ja: 間違ってると思う?

key: prove it.
en: prove it.
ja: 証明してみて。

key: oh my god, FINE.
en: oh my god, FINE.
ja: はぁもう、わかったわよ。

key: usually people give up if you just say the same thing over and over but even I'M getting bored by this now.
en: usually people give up if you just say the same thing over and over but even I'M getting bored by this now.
ja: 普通は同じこと繰り返し言えば諦めるもんなんだけど、さすがのアタシもこれには飽きてきた。

key: keep your stupid 32 kb or whatever of captive animal friends if it makes you feel happy.
en: keep your stupid 32 kb or whatever of captive animal friends if it makes you feel happy.
ja: それで幸せになれるなら、その32キロバイトかなんかのバカみたいな囚われの動物友達、そのまま持ってていいわよ。

key: there should be a TV show for people like you.
en: there should be a TV show for people like you.
ja: あんたみたいな人向けのテレビ番組、あってもいいくらい。

key: have fun rationalizing slavery and imprisonment to yourself at night.
en: have fun rationalizing slavery and imprisonment to yourself at night.
ja: 夜、自分に奴隷制と監禁を正当化しながら、せいぜい楽しんでね。

key: ever considered going to the olympics?
en: ever considered going to the olympics?
ja: オリンピック出場、考えたことある?

key: pretty sure you'd win the gold for mental gymnastics.
en: pretty sure you'd win the gold for mental gymnastics.
ja: へ理屈体操で金メダル取れると思うわよ。

key: bye.
en: bye.
ja: じゃあね。

key: thought so.
en: thought so.
ja: だと思った。

key: we can do this all day, \PN.
en: we can do this all day, \PN.
ja: 一日中でもこれ続けられるからね、\PN。

key: i'm certainly not going anywhere.
en: i'm certainly not going anywhere.
ja: アタシはどこにも行かないし。

key: and neither are you.
en: and neither are you.
ja: あんたもよ。

key: no matter how stubborn you may think you are.
en: no matter how stubborn you may think you are.
ja: 自分がどれだけ頑固だと思ってても関係ない。

key: ...but i guess it's not like you have that many pokemon in your boxes.
en: ...but i guess it's not like you have that many pokemon in your boxes.
ja: …でもまあ、ボックスにそんなにたくさんポケモンがいるわけでもないんでしょ。

key: so maybe you get it already.
en: so maybe you get it already.
ja: だからもう、わかってるのかもね。

key: fine, whatever.
en: fine, whatever.
ja: はいはい、もういいわ。

key: i guess i can stop moralizing to myself.
en: i guess i can stop moralizing to myself.
ja: 自分に説教するのはこの辺でやめとく。

key: just go.
en: just go.
ja: もう行きなさい。

key: but think about it, ok?
en: but think about it, ok?

key: you'll forget about this adventure too, eventually.
en: you'll forget about this adventure too, eventually.
ja: この冒険のことも、いずれ忘れちゃうんだから。

key: BRESLIN: Originally we followed that Pokémon here.
en: BRESLIN: Originally we followed that Pokémon here.
ja: ブレスリン: もともとは、あのポケモンを追ってここまで来たんだ。

key: It seems this was its den, so we found some weak Pokémon to lure it away.
en: It seems this was its den, so we found some weak Pokémon to lure it away.
ja: ここがねぐらだったみたいでな、弱いポケモンを見つけて誘き出したのさ。

key: We figured if they were in danger, it'd come running,
en: We figured if they were in danger, it'd come running,
ja: そいつらが危険な目に遭えば、駆けつけてくるだろうと踏んでたんだが、

key: And we were right.
en: And we were right.
ja: その通りだった。

key: ARC: So, for the sake of your business, you'll even hurt other Pokémon.
en: ARC: So, for the sake of your business, you'll even hurt other Pokémon.
ja: アーク: つまり、商売のためなら他のポケモンを傷つけることもいとわないってわけか。

key: BRESLIN: Hey, don't give me that.
en: BRESLIN: Hey, don't give me that.

key: Business is business, and we've all got mouths to feed.
en: Business is business, and we've all got mouths to feed.
ja: 商売は商売だ、こっちだって食わせなきゃならん口があるんでな。

key: ARC: Some of us find better ways to do it.
en: ARC: Some of us find better ways to do it.
ja: アーク: もっとマシなやり方を見つける奴もいるけどな。

key: BRESLIN: We can't all be bleeding hearts like you.
en: BRESLIN: We can't all be bleeding hearts like you.
ja: ブレスリン: 誰もがお前みたいに情け深くはいられねえのさ。

key: For my crew, this is all they know.
en: For my crew, this is all they know.
ja: 俺のクルーにとっちゃ、これしか知らねえんだよ。

key: It's a lot rougher out where we come from.
en: It's a lot rougher out where we come from.
ja: 俺たちの出てきたところは、もっと荒れてたんでな。

key: ARC: And that's an excuse?
en: ARC: And that's an excuse?
ja: アーク: それが言い訳になるのか?

key: Reborn ain't exactly been all sunshine and rainbows all the time either.
en: Reborn ain't exactly been all sunshine and rainbows all the time either.
ja: リボーンだって、ずっと平和で明るかったわけじゃねえぜ。

key: It's up to us to make a better future, not just maintain a sour status quo.
en: It's up to us to make a better future, not just maintain a sour status quo.
ja: 険悪な現状を維持するんじゃなく、もっとマシな未来を作るのは俺たち次第だ。

key: BRESLIN: And how exactly do you suggest I do that?
en: BRESLIN: And how exactly do you suggest I do that?
ja: ブレスリン: で、具体的にどうしろって言うんだ?

key: You got any bright ideas for me?
en: You got any bright ideas for me?
ja: 何か名案でもあんのか?

key: ARC: Friend, I can't solve those problems for you.
en: ARC: Friend, I can't solve those problems for you.
ja: アーク: 相棒、その問題を俺が代わりに解決してやることはできねえよ。

key: I made my way already.
en: I made my way already.
ja: 俺はもう自分の道を切り拓いた。

key: Built a show from the ground up one viewer at a time, and you better believe it's the only good thing anyone in my family ever did,
en: Built a show from the ground up one viewer at a time, and you better believe it's the only good thing anyone in my family ever did,
ja: 視聴者を一人ずつ増やしながら、ゼロから番組を作り上げてきた。それが俺の家族の中で誰かが成し遂げたたった一つのまともなことだって、信じてくれていいぜ、

key: But I did it.
en: But I did it.
ja: だが、俺はやり遂げた。

key: I can't show you what's gonna work for you,
en: I can't show you what's gonna work for you,
ja: お前にとって何がうまくいくかは、俺には見せてやれねえ、

key: Because if you aren't the one figuring it out step by step, then how can you say you're walking your own path?
en: Because if you aren't the one figuring it out step by step, then how can you say you're walking your own path?
ja: だって、一歩一歩自分で見つけ出さなきゃ、それを自分の道を歩いてるとは言えねえだろ?

key: However, I can tell you that this--
en: However, I can tell you that this--
ja: でもよ、これだけは言わせてくれ――

key: Dragging two regional superstars who should probably be arresting you into a dimensional void to save your backside--
en: Dragging two regional superstars who should probably be arresting you into a dimensional void to save your backside--
ja: 本来お前を逮捕すべき、地方の有名人二人を次元の裂け目まで引きずり込んで、お前の尻を救わせるようなこの状況――

key: This ain't it.
en: This ain't it.
ja: これは違うんじゃねえか。

key: Do better.
en: Do better.
ja: もっとマシにやれ。

key: BRESLIN: I asked for your help, not your morality.
en: BRESLIN: I asked for your help, not your morality.
ja: ブレスリン: 頼んだのは助けだ、道徳の講釈じゃねえ。

key: ARC: It's a package deal, friend.
en: ARC: It's a package deal, friend.
ja: アーク: そいつはセットになってるもんでな、相棒。

key: But good advice, I promise-- try to make the most of it.
en: But good advice, I promise-- try to make the most of it.
ja: でも約束するぜ、いいアドバイスだ――ちゃんと活かせよ。

key: BRESLIN: Look, let's just focus on getting to the exit.
en: BRESLIN: Look, let's just focus on getting to the exit.
ja: ブレスリン: とにかく、出口に向かうことに集中しようぜ。

key: The ground in this area reacts to an electric current that seems to make some pathways float.
en: The ground in this area reacts to an electric current that seems to make some pathways float.
ja: この辺りの地面は電流に反応して、通路が浮かび上がるみたいだ。

key: There's certain stones that need to be activated to move forward.
en: There's certain stones that need to be activated to move forward.
ja: 先に進むには、特定の石を起動させる必要がある。

key: You'll know them because they stand taller than any others around here.
en: You'll know them because they stand taller than any others around here.
ja: この辺の他の石より背が高いから、すぐわかるはずだ。

key: I don't imagine heroes like you will have any trouble tracking them down...
en: I don't imagine heroes like you will have any trouble tracking them down...
ja: お前らみたいなヒーローなら、見つけるのに苦労はしねえだろうよ…

key: ARC: All this to get to your crew?
en: ARC: All this to get to your crew?
ja: アーク: これ全部、お前のクルーにたどり着くためか?

key: BRESLIN: I asked one of the guys to create a discharge and knock the pathways out so we wouldn't be followed.
en: BRESLIN: I asked one of the guys to create a discharge and knock the pathways out so we wouldn't be followed.
ja: ブレスリン: 追われないように、仲間の一人に放電させて通路を落としてもらったんだよ。

key: Safer that way-- but no worries, if you touch the stones they should light right up.
en: Safer that way-- but no worries, if you touch the stones they should light right up.
ja: その方が安全だからな――でも心配すんな、石に触れりゃすぐ光るはずだ。

key: ARC: Uh-huh.
en: ARC: Uh-huh.
ja: アーク: へえ。

key: \PN, why don't you press ahead?
en: \PN, why don't you press ahead?
ja: \PN、お前は先に進んでくれよ。

key: Breslin and I are gonna hang back and have a bit more of a talk about where their little team is going.
en: Breslin and I are gonna hang back and have a bit more of a talk about where their little team is going.
ja: 俺とブレスリンは残って、そいつらの小さなチームがこれからどうなるか、もう少し話しておくからよ。

key: BRESLIN: You mean, where we can bring them to be safe from that woman?
en: BRESLIN: You mean, where we can bring them to be safe from that woman?
ja: ブレスリン: つまり、あの女から安全な場所に連れて行けるかって話だろ?

key: ARC: And other things.
en: ARC: And other things.
ja: アーク: それと、他にもいろいろな。

key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 壊すにも動かすにも頑丈すぎるようだ…

key: The rock base may hold more valuables.
en: The rock base may hold more valuables.
ja: 岩の土台の中に、さらに貴重なものが隠れているかもしれない。

key: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: ばくはつのこなで開けますか?

key: ARC: I don't understand how you can let yourself get by on hurting others.
en: ARC: I don't understand how you can let yourself get by on hurting others.
ja: アーク: 他人を傷つけて生きていくなんて、俺には理解できねえよ。

key: BRESLIN: To live is to take, see?
en: BRESLIN: To live is to take, see?
ja: ブレスリン: 生きるってのは奪うことだろ、なあ?

key: There's no co-existence without some casualties.
en: There's no co-existence without some casualties.
ja: 犠牲なしの共存なんてありゃしねえよ。

key: ARC: I don't disagree some of that's unavoidable, but that's why you've gotta at least try.
en: ARC: I don't disagree some of that's unavoidable, but that's why you've gotta at least try.
ja: アーク: 避けられねえこともあるってのは否定しねえ。だからこそ、せめて努力しなきゃならねえんだ。

key: You can make a net positive, but not if you give up from the get-go like so.
en: You can make a net positive, but not if you give up from the get-go like so.
ja: 最初っからそうやって諦めてちゃ、プラスになんて持っていけねえぜ。

key: BRESLIN: You having trouble?
en: BRESLIN: You having trouble?
ja: ブレスリン: 苦労してるのか?

key: All you gotta do is open up a path further into the den by activating the tall stones-- like the ones just up behind me, see?
en: All you gotta do is open up a path further into the den by activating the tall stones-- like the ones just up behind me, see?
ja: 背の高い石を起動させて、ねぐらの奥へと道を開けりゃいいだけだ――ほら、俺の後ろにあるみたいなやつをな。

key: There's three nearby in high places, and three elsewhere scattered around here.
en: There's three nearby in high places, and three elsewhere scattered around here.
ja: 近くの高いところに3つ、それとこの辺の他の場所にさらに3つ散らばってる。

key: Just touch 'em and they'll light right up.
en: Just touch 'em and they'll light right up.
ja: 触るだけで、すぐ光るはずだ。

key: ???: So, you're the one giving us a hand?
en: ???: So, you're the one giving us a hand?
ja: ???: あんたが手を貸してくれてるってわけか?

key: Hope our boss hasn't given you a hard time.
en: Hope our boss hasn't given you a hard time.
ja: うちのボスがあんたに手荒な真似してなきゃいいけどな。

key: They can be a bit rough sometimes.
en: They can be a bit rough sometimes.
ja: 時々ちょっと荒っぽいからよ。

key: BRESLIN: I'll remember that next pay day, Ein.
en: BRESLIN: I'll remember that next pay day, Ein.
ja: ブレスリン: 次の給料日に覚えとくぜ、アイン。

key: BRESLIN: Glad to see she hasn't gotten on your case for lying down on the job, buddy.
en: BRESLIN: Glad to see she hasn't gotten on your case for lying down on the job, buddy.
ja: ブレスリン: 仕事サボってあいつに絞られてないみたいで安心したぜ、相棒。

key: EIN: Ha-ha. Funny as always, Bres.
en: EIN: Ha-ha. Funny as always, Bres.
ja: アイン: ハハ。相変わらず面白いな、ブレス。

key: ARC: Those marks don't look great...
en: ARC: Those marks don't look great...
ja: アーク: その傷、あまりよくなさそうだが…

key: Was it your employer, or the Pokémon that did this?
en: Was it your employer, or the Pokémon that did this?
ja: それをやったのは雇い主か、それともポケモンか?

key: EIN: Little of column A, little of column B.
en: EIN: Little of column A, little of column B.
ja: アイン: どっちも少しずつってとこだ。

key: Neither of them much seemed to care I was standing between 'em.
en: Neither of them much seemed to care I was standing between 'em.
ja: どっちも、俺が間に立ってることなんて気にしてなかったみたいでな。

key: BRESLIN: Hence the intervention.
en: BRESLIN: Hence the intervention.
ja: ブレスリン: だから割って入ったってわけだ。

key: ARC: He's going to need medical help, double time.
en: ARC: He's going to need medical help, double time.
ja: アーク: こいつ、大至急手当てが必要だぜ。

key: EIN: The others are still out there--
en: EIN: The others are still out there--
ja: アイン: 他の連中はまだ外にいる――

key: We chased the thing through this area into a forest of some kind...
en: We chased the thing through this area into a forest of some kind...
ja: あいつを追ってこの辺りを通って、なんかの森まで行ったんだが…

key: BRESLIN: Even now they might still be in jeopardy, huh?
en: BRESLIN: Even now they might still be in jeopardy, huh?
ja: ブレスリン: 今もまだ危ない目に遭ってるかもしれねえってことか。

key: ARC: Let's get your friend out of here.
en: ARC: Let's get your friend out of here.
ja: アーク: お前の仲間をここから運び出そうぜ。

key: I can at least offer some basic first aid, but the first step is to step back to safe ground.
en: I can at least offer some basic first aid, but the first step is to step back to safe ground.
ja: 簡単な応急処置くらいなら俺にもできる。でもまずは安全な場所まで戻らねえとな。

key: \PN, I'm gonna have to leave it to you to find the rest of their team and get them out.
en: \PN, I'm gonna have to leave it to you to find the rest of their team and get them out.
ja: \PN、残りのチームを見つけて連れ出すのは、お前に任せることになりそうだ。

key: BRESLIN: There's three more of us.
en: BRESLIN: There's three more of us.
ja: ブレスリン: あと3人いる。

key: Further in, no doubt, and heads harder than any Shieldon.
en: Further in, no doubt, and heads harder than any Shieldon.
ja: 間違いなくもっと奥にいるし、どのタテトプスより頭が固いやつらだ。

key: I doubt they'll pull out without a fight-- but better they lose to you than end up like this lout.
en: I doubt they'll pull out without a fight-- but better they lose to you than end up like this lout.
ja: 戦わずに退くとは思えねえが――こいつみたいになるよりは、お前に負ける方がマシだろうぜ。

key: EIN: Reallll funny...
en: EIN: Reallll funny...
ja: アイン: ほーんと、面白いよ…

key: BRESLIN: You can jape when you're in better health, my friend.
en: BRESLIN: You can jape when you're in better health, my friend.
ja: ブレスリン: 軽口たたくのは、もっと元気になってからにしろよ、相棒。

key: For now, get on my back. We're getting you outta here.
en: For now, get on my back. We're getting you outta here.
ja: とにかく今は俺の背中に乗れ。ここから連れ出してやる。

key: ARC: I'll lead the way. We'll get him cleaned up in the span of two commercial breaks or less.
en: ARC: I'll lead the way. We'll get him cleaned up in the span of two commercial breaks or less.
ja: アーク: 俺が先導する。CM2回分もかからず、こいつをきれいにしてやろうぜ。

key: BRESLIN: You just close your eyes and hang tight, Ein.
en: BRESLIN: You just close your eyes and hang tight, Ein.
ja: ブレスリン: お前は目を閉じてじっとしてろ、アイン。

key: Let's go, let's go...
en: Let's go, let's go...
ja: 行くぞ、行くぞ…

key: BRESLIN: Oh, and one more thing...
en: BRESLIN: Oh, and one more thing...
ja: ブレスリン: ああ、それともう一つ…

key: We may have... "borrowed" a few Mega Stones from our past employers, so you may end up having to fight one or two of those.
en: We may have... "borrowed" a few Mega Stones from our past employers, so you may end up having to fight one or two of those.
ja: 俺たち……前の雇い主から、メガストーンを何個か『拝借』しちまっててな、だから一人二人と戦う羽目になるかもしれねえ。

key: Put up a good fight, champ.
en: Put up a good fight, champ.
ja: いい戦いを見せてくれよ、チャンプ。

key: I'm sure you're capable enough.
en: I'm sure you're capable enough.
ja: お前ならやれるはずだ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
